title: State-of-the-Art Arabic Language Modeling with Sparse MoE Fine-Tuning and Chain-of-Thought Distillation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated using the AraTrust benchmark to detect culture-specific risks, safety, and cultural trustworthiness, alongside checking model alignment with regional ethical norms through a culturally-grounded Chain-of-Thought (CoT) distillation process.

Assessed by measuring the model's performance on Arabic syntax and morphological complexities using the MadinahQA benchmark, designed to counteract the brittleness and Anglocentric bias of proprietary models that lack dialectal and morpho-syntactic robustness.
